races.paceDynamic: Nordic Norm and Beta Reader will contest early pace, with Nordic Norm likely to secure an uncontested lead as Beta Reader may sit just off the pace. The massive contingent of hold-up horses (Magical Merlin, Penfolds Grange, Havana Touch, Caph Star, Billy Mill, King Of Charm, Chico Dulce) creates a bunched field that will rely on Nordic Norm's tempo to set up their finishing kicks over this testing mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Nordic Norm Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Nordic Norm gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Nordic Norm's proven front-running ability on good ground allows him to steal a march on the hold-up brigade. The closers struggle to peg back his advantage despite late rallies.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady and the field stays bunched until the final 2f
scenarios.body: The wall of hold-up horses gets organized late with Caph Star and Penfolds Grange leading the charge from the pack. Nordic Norm's early advantage gets swamped by superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Positioning Key
scenarios.trigger: If Beta Reader presses Nordic Norm creating honest pace throughout
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favors horses that can travel strongly in behind without being too far back. Billy Mill and Magical Merlin benefit from prominent tracking positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both Nordic Norm and Beta Reader go too slow early creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure dash from the 3f pole with the best raw speed winning regardless of position. Chico Dulce's recent winning form gives him the edge in a messy scramble.

watchPoints.text: Nordic Norm breaking smartly and getting first run - if unopposed early he becomes very dangerous
Beta Reader's positioning in first 2f - if tracking Nordic Norm closely the pace will be more honest
Caph Star's position turning for home - needs to be within 4 lengths to unleash his proven finishing kick
How bunched the field remains at halfway - if strung out early the hold-up horses lose their advantage
Penfolds Grange getting clear racing room in final 2f - cramped quarters would ruin his chances

races.paceDynamic: Pureis King is the only confirmed front runner and will likely lead from the start, setting a sustainable pace without pressure in this hold-up heavy field. With 11 of 13 runners showing hold-up tendencies, this creates a tactical bottleneck where positioning and timing will be crucial, potentially suiting those who can sit closer to the pace or find clear runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pureis King maintains an easy lead without pressure through slow fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets an armchair ride and kicks clear, while the hold-up brigade leaves it too late from the back. Despite his modest rating, the tactical advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely run and Pureis King weakens in the final furlong as expected
scenarios.body: The superior-rated hold-up horses time their challenges perfectly as the leader fades. Balzac and Winding Stream, with recent good form, lead the charge from the back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates interference and several hold-up horses get blocked for runs
scenarios.body: Those drawn favorably or getting first run have a decisive advantage while others are caught in traffic. Clear passages become more valuable than pure ability in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantities Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Fizzy Bear or Madame Passant show significant improvement
scenarios.body: One of the unexposed runners capitalizes on a slowly-run race with a turn of foot the exposed horses cannot match. Their unknown style gives them tactical flexibility.

watchPoints.text: Pureis King getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive despite his low rating and fade tendency
Traffic problems likely in straight with 11 hold-up horses all seeking clear runs simultaneously
Fizzy Bear and Madame Passant are complete unknowns whose improvement could surprise the market
Winding Stream's recent winning form from hold-up style makes him dangerous if getting clear run
West Hill Rosie and Tiny Tiger both show concerning fade patterns that could repeat under pressure

races.paceDynamic: Pints In Peace will likely lead or sit prominent early with Black Endeavour potentially tracking, creating a modest but sustainable pace in this small field. With six hold-up horses including the top-rated trio of Shafi, Deluded, and Twilight Glow, the pace will be genuine but not suicidal, setting up a tactical finish where positioning and timing will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace suits closers
scenarios.trigger: If Pints In Peace and Black Endeavour maintain steady fractions without getting into a duel
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup with Shafi, Deluded, and Lion Of Mali all arriving late. The pace proves just quick enough to string out the field and favor the strongest finishers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical crawl becomes sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners get shuffled back or restrained, creating a slow early pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 2-furlong dash where the horse with the best turn of foot wins regardless of style. Fresh speed and class tell over stamina and positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front two maintain advantage
scenarios.trigger: If Pints In Peace and Black Endeavour work together and kick clear approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The early leaders build an unassailable advantage while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. Pints In Peace's recent 7f wins show he can see out this trip under pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-race pressure creates chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses attempt to challenge the leaders simultaneously at halfway, creating a fierce gallop
scenarios.body: The sustained pressure from 4f out breaks up the field completely and favors horses with proven stamina. The race falls apart for many, creating opportunities for those who handle the pace.

races.paceDynamic: Parisian Scholar will take this race along from the front with no other confirmed leaders, creating a measured tempo early that should suit the patient closers. The four hold-up horses (Moment Of Light, Green Falcon, Devil's Peak) plus prominent runner Starship Trooper will settle behind, setting up a finish where positioning and late kick will be crucial over the extended 1m3f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Parisian Scholar gets soft splits and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The leader sustains a workable gallop without pressure, then has enough left to resist the closers in the straight. The hold-up brigade leave their runs fractionally late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and closers get clear runs
scenarios.body: The measured early tempo leaves plenty in the tank for the final furlong battles. Moment Of Light and Green Falcon unleash devastating finishes from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Profits
scenarios.trigger: If Starship Trooper tracks the leader perfectly and strikes early
scenarios.body: The only prominent runner positions ideally behind Parisian Scholar and makes his move before the hold-up horses can respond. His superior tactical position proves decisive over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the field gets bunched and several runners meet trouble in running
scenarios.body: Poor positioning and lack of room causes interference among the closers in the straight. The race falls to whichever horse gets the clearest passage rather than pure ability.

races.paceDynamic: Chhota Saab will lead virtually uncontested with five prominent runners (Uniter, Lovethiswayagain, Anorah Unleashed, Fullstop, Runamara) sitting close behind, creating a sustainable early gallop. The pace will gradually intensify from the 3f pole as the prominent brigade challenges Chhota Saab, setting up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses (Corniche Girl, Madman, Jungle Knight, Stock Market) to deliver late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Chhota Saab leads comfortably without early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace stays steady until 3f out when Uniter and Lovethiswayagain challenge, creating ideal conditions for strong finishers. Corniche Girl and Madman get perfect splits to unleash devastating late kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Lovethiswayagain or Uniter apply early pressure to Chhota Saab creating a genuine gallop
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo plays to horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and sustain their effort. Lovethiswayagain's recent placings suggest readiness for breakthrough while Arry Up can capitalize from his handy position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals
scenarios.trigger: If Chhota Saab gets an easy lead and the prominent runners fail to apply enough pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows Chhota Saab to dictate terms completely and kick clear before the hold-up horses can organize. Fullstop and Runamara may get close but the leader has too much rope.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners jostle for position early, creating an uneven gallop
scenarios.body: The irregular rhythm disrupts both front runners and hold-up horses, favoring versatile types who can adapt. Madman's recent win suggests he can handle tactical complications while Jungle Knight may find openings in the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: True Promise is the sole early pace angle in a field dominated by hold-up performers, meaning she can dictate terms uncontested through moderate fractions. With nine hold-up horses including Em Four, State Of Madness, and Brazen Idol all needing to be delivered late, this sets up a tactical affair where True Promise's sustained gallop could prove decisive if the closing kick comes too late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: True Promise Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise gets easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage as the field of closers gets in each other's way in the final furlong. Hold-up horses find too much to do despite superior ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closer Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise stops quickly and pace collapses final 2f
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace sets up perfectly for the superior hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks. Em Four and State Of Madness benefit most from their higher ratings in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Alpine Girl Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Alpine Girl gets perfect trip tracking True Promise throughout
scenarios.body: Alpine Girl's recent Kempton win gives her course confidence and she times her run to perfection as True Promise weakens. Her proven 6f speed at this track becomes the decisive factor.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Middleton View Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If pace is genuinely strong and Middleton View gets rails run
scenarios.body: The hold-up specialist finds the gaps along the inside as favorites get shuffled wide in the straight. Her perfect record on good ground and tactical positioning overcome the ratings deficit.
